title: Simple Grace Period
description: Simple Grace Period adds a grace period to minecraft that is controlled with a command book.
body:
# About Simple Grace Period
Simple Grace Period is a datapack that adds a 30 minute grace period.

## How to use it?
To use Simple  Grace period run this command:

```
/function gp:command_book
```

This gives you a book with buttons that controls the whole datapack!


Note - Operator is required to get the command book.
